question:
Choose the correct one-word substitute for:

“To depart suddenly to avoid notice”.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 (Abscond)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Abscond"** means to leave hurriedly and secretly, typically to avoid detection or arrest for an unlawful act. (गायब हो जाना / भाग जाना)
 
 
• **Example: **The thief absconded with the stolen money before the police arrived.
 
 
 
• This word is often used in legal contexts or when referring to someone who evades responsibilities or consequences by disappearing.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 (Abscond)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Wander** (घूमना): To move about aimlessly or without a fixed course.
 
 
• **Example:** He likes to wander through the forest to clear his mind.
 
 
 
• **Roam** (भटकना): To travel aimlessly or without a specific destination.
 
 
• **Example:** The students roamed around the city after their exams.
 
 
 
• **Delay** (विलंब): To postpone or put off an action or event.
 
 
• **Example:** The train was delayed due to technical issues.
